plugin.name: Scarface Fusion Fix
SkipIntro.description: Skip legal screens, startup logos and the single-button load-success notice. Profile selection and real choices remain available.
GamepadIcons.description: Controller artwork and controls-menu names. Auto uses Xbox; choose PlayStation, Nintendo or another set for your controller. Changes apply while playing.
ScrollWeaponsWithMouseWheel.description: Scroll weapons with the mouse wheel.
VehicleCameraRecenterDelay.description: Seconds after you last turned the vehicle camera with the mouse or stick before it turns back behind the vehicle. 0 turns it back at once.
OnFootCameraRecenterDelay.description: Seconds after you last turned the camera with the mouse or stick before it swings back behind Tony while he moves. 0 keeps the original behavior: the camera follows at once.
WalkKey.description: Hold this key to walk instead of running on foot.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto uses the whole screen width: HUD elements at the sides go to the screen's edges. A ratio such as 16:9 keeps them in a centered box of that aspect.
RestoreCharacterBlood.description: Restore the blood on characters from the PS2 version.
RestoreWindowDamage.description: Restore the cracked glass on damaged car windows from the console versions.
ConsoleGamma.description: Use the console gamma curve for deeper colors and more contrast.
camera.fovfactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay field of view, up to 150 degrees across. A value of 1.0 keeps the original view unless it exceeds that limit. Aim, zoom, scripted views and camera transitions retain their original framing.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a window with a frame at the chosen resolution, or borderless at the desktop resolution. Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and the last window mode.
RawInputMouse.description: Read the mouse directly for the camera and the map: no pointer acceleration and no lost movement at the screen's edges. Off uses the cursor.
MouseSensitivity.description: Multiplies the game's mouse sensitivity for the camera and the map.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pause the game and its sound while its window isn't active. Off keeps it running in the background. The game pauses while minimized and restores its display when reopened.
CutsceneBorders.description: Both keeps the original cinematic frame with borders at any aspect ratio. Off removes the borders and fills the screen, showing more at the sides on wider screens. Letterbox and Pillarbox retain only the named borders.
FPSLimit.description: Limit the frame rate to 30–1000, the monitor refresh rate, or Unlimited.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the game window while the game is active. It is released when the game loses the focus, while the window is moved and at once when this is turned off.
AntiAliasing.description: SMAA anti-aliasing. Needs the game's own anti-aliasing to be off.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
update.availablehub: An update for Scarface Fusion Fix is available. FusionFixHub will open after you exit the game.
update.availablesite: An update for Scarface Fusion Fix is available at fusionfix.io.
checkupdates.description: Checks for a new fix version once when enabled. A notice appears in Settings; FusionFixHub opens after the game exits if it is installed. Off makes no network request.
GamepadCameraSpeed.description: Multiplies the native right-stick camera input. Does not change mouse sensitivity.
textlanguage.description: Language of the fix's own texts. Auto follows the game's language.
SkipPressStart.description: Go directly to profile selection instead of waiting at the press-to-start screen. Restart to apply.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original fits the whole movie within a 4:3 area. Fill fits the whole movie within the screen. Neither crops or stretches the picture.
